extracted.intended_audience: K–12 teachers, literacy coaches, and school-based educators
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and downloadable rubrics (K–2 and 3–12) for assessing student writing using the 6+1 Trait Model to tailor instruction and build common classroom writing processes and vocabulary across text types.

rubrics_metrics.name: 6+1 Trait Model of Instruction & Assessment
rubrics_metrics.description: The core of the 6+1 Trait Model of Instruction & Assessment is the set of rubrics that specify how to assess the quality of student writing and tailor instruction to students’ needs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These rubrics are the central instrument for assessing student writing quality and guiding instruction; they were refined in 2018 to respond to field feedback and developments in standards and assessments.

rubrics_metrics.name: K–2 Rubric
rubrics_metrics.description: K–2 rubric supports teachers and students as they are starting to write, creating classroom writing processes, building a common vocabulary, and establishing a vision for good writing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Intended for early elementary classrooms to scaffold beginning writers; designed to help establish classroom routines and a shared language about writing. (Download available.)

rubrics_metrics.name: 3–12 Rubric
rubrics_metrics.description: 3–12 rubric is often used in late second or third grades and into higher grade levels.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Intended for upper-elementary through secondary grades; supports assessment and instruction as students advance beyond the earliest writing stages. (Download available.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Use across text types (informative/explanatory, argument, narrative)
rubrics_metrics.description: The rubrics are designed for easier use across text types (i.e., informative/explanatory, argument, and narrative writing).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rubrics are field tested, research-based, and teacher friendly so they can be applied consistently across multiple writing genres and instructional contexts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Formatting/printing instructions for rubric materials
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Flip on long edge, open to left, and make sure orientation is set manually to landscape.
